sloka: अन्ये मध्येन गच्चन्ति पार्श्वतो अन्ये प्लवम् गमाः ।सलिले प्रपतन्ति अन्ये मार्गम् अन्ये न लेभिरे ॥६-२२-८३॥।।
transliteration: anye madhyena gaccanti pārśvato anye plavam gamāḥ ।salile prapatanti anye mārgam anye na lebhire ॥6-22-83॥।।

translations.english: While some monkeys walked in the middle some went in the side, some others were falling down in water (for the want of space to walk) some others went like birds in the path of the sky.
